text:
Emma Li: heads up :warning: deploybot alerted a p99 spike (~3%) on the quant-int8 path for runtime-engine v2.4.3 in us-west-2. seeing small increase in tail latency and a few evictions. propose partial slice rollback -> pin kernel to v2.4.2 at 20% traffic and ramp down affected buckets.
DeployBot: created rollback run and prepared commands. suggested slice=20%, ramp=5% every 3m. link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/runs/DRP-7821
Samir Patel: can you paste the p99 graph + eviction counters? curious if it's kernel-level or driver-level.
Emma Li: attaching quick snapshot (cut): p99 220ms -> 238ms after 10:12 deploy, eviction rate +0.4% on quant-int8. dashboard: https://telemetry.redwood/internal/d/engine/p99?org=infra
Liam O'Connor: +1 to partial rollback. prefer progressive ramp: 20% target but start at 5% and validate no new OOMs/evictions. smoke tests on stage and prod-slice required.
Jessica Chow: will update release notes and changelog with "rollback v2.4.3 -> kernel v2.4.2 due to p99 regression on quant-int8; follow-up triage open." Also add a short blurb for postmortem.
Rachel Kim: I'll run the smoke suite on the 5% slice and run the perf microbench (matmul, kv-cache stress). give me a thumbs when pinned. ETA ~8m.
OpsBot: pin applied: runtime-engine kernel pinned -> v2.4.2, slice=20% (ramp plan pending). TTL=60m. See: https://ops.redwood/pins/4971
Henry Park: approved. proceed with staged rollout and hold for 15m after reaching 20% before further action.
Alex Rivera: recommend sticky-pin TTL 30m then auto-unpin check; if metrics stable at 30m extend TTL, else escalate. also set deploybot rate-limit to 50rps for the pinned slice to reduce noise.
Samir Patel: quick log grep shows ~0.5% of requests hitting "matmul: illegal alignment" warnings on int8 path. might be a codegen edge. tagging eng-runtime-ml for triage.
Liam O'Connor: if it's codegen we should parallelize triage: eng-runtime debug mem alignment + reconfirm quant build flags. Emma, please create a follow-up issue and assign. For now run rollback ramp as planned.
Emma Li: opening ENG-RUNTIME-8601 with logs + smoke results, tagging @eng-ml and @eng-runtime. proceeding with 5% -> 10% -> 20% ramps, 3m between steps. Rachel start smoke now.
DeployBot: executing step 1 -> set slice to 5% (timestamp 3781234574). command: ```
deploybot rollback --service runtime-engine --to kernel-v2.4.2 --slice 5% --ramp 5% --interval 3m
```
Rachel Kim: smoke passed for 5% (latency within baseline, no new evictions). moving to 10% after validation.
DeployBot: executing step 2 -> set slice to 10% (timestamp 3781234582).
Rachel Kim: 10% smoke looks clean so far. continuing to 20% in 3m.
DeployBot: executing step 3 -> set slice to 20% (timestamp 3781234590). rollback run complete to target slice. hold window started.
Emma Li: thanks all. triage thread ENG-RUNTIME-8601 will capture root cause. for runbook: keep pin until postmortem, auto-unpin if stable for 2h unless eng-runtime requests extension.
